claims.claim: Anthropic announced that Claude discovered a previously unknown enzyme system in bacteriophages with features similar to CRISPR.
claims.episode_span: Scientists at Anthropic just announced that their AI model Claude found a completely new enzyme system hiding in the DNA of bacteriophages — viruses that infect bacteria.
